subject: Recap & next steps - Aurora Tech discovery (economic buyer & procurement)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Clark <emma.clark@auroratech.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps - Aurora Tech discovery

Thanks again for taking time today, Emma - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Objective: evaluate Redwood to reduce inference cost for Aurora's real-time assistant and improve 99th percentile latency for multi-region customers.
- Success criteria you shared: (1) take cost per session down by ~30% vs current baseline, (2) sub-250ms P50 inference time for 1k concurrent sessions, (3) no customer-facing regressions on top-5 prompts.
- Timeline: pilot in Q3, decision by end of Q3 to align budget cycle.
- Technical constraints: data residency for EU customers, SOC 2 evidence, and SSO (SAML/SCIM).

Action items / asks: 
1) Please confirm who the economic buyer is (name & title) so we can align the ROI and license discussion.
2) Please introduce the procurement/security contacts so we can send the SOC 2 report and your procurement/PO templates.
3) Would you and the economic buyer be available for a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the proposed pilot approach and pricing bands?

I attached the call notes for your reference. I'll also include a short security one-pager and our SOC2 link once you confirm the right contacts.

Thanks - happy to adapt based on your timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachment: 20270509-aurora-discussion-notes.pdf

From: Emma Clark <emma.clark@auroratech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps - Aurora Tech discovery

Thanks Marissa - great recap. Quick answers below and a couple of notes.

- Economic buyer: Daniel Ruiz, VP Product (daniel.ruiz@auroratech.com). He owns the product budget and will want to see the ROI case.
- Procurement contact: Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@auroratech.com) - she handles contracts/POs. I'll loop her in on the procurement items.

A few additional notes: Daniel will want a clear pilot success definition tied to usage metrics. Procurement will ask about standard PO terms and whether Redwood supports net-30. Security will want to review SOC 2 and a short list of data flows for the pilot.

Looping in Priya and Daniel on this thread. Happy to set a time next week - afternoons PST work best for us.

Thanks,
Emma
Senior PM, Aurora Tech
emma.clark@auroratech.com

Subject: Intro + next steps: pilot scope, security & procurement checklist

Hi Daniel & Priya - nice to e-meet. Per my conversation with Emma, Aurora is evaluating Redwood for a Q3 pilot focused on cost reduction and latency improvements for your real-time assistant. 

Immediate items we can help with: 
- Security: attaching our one-pager and linking to the most recent SOC 2 report. Please let us know if you need a completed security questionnaire.
- Procurement: we can accept PO and have standard Net-30 terms; we can also discuss alternatives if needed. I'll attach a sample SOW/pilot addendum for your review.
- Pilot scope: proposed 6-week pilot, 2 endpoints (EU + US), success metrics: 30% cost reduction target, maintain quality on benchmark prompts, and sub-250ms P50 for typical sessions.

Proposed times for a 30-min alignment call next week (PST): 
- Tue 2027-05-11 11:00am
- Wed 2027-05-12 2:00pm
- Thu 2027-05-13 4:00pm

If those don't work, share a couple windows that fit your schedule. Attaching: Redwood-Security-OnePager.pdf. SOC2: https://redwood.com/security/soc2-report.pdf

Thanks - looking forward to the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps: pilot scope, security & procurement checklist

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the materials. A few procurement/security asks before we lock a meeting: 

1) Please send your standard PO/contract template or confirm you can work off our PO (attached).
2) Provide basic SSO integration notes (SAML + SCIM) and any rollout considerations for pilot users.
3) We require three client references for pilots with similar scale; please share names and a 1-line use case for each.
4) Confirm Net-30 on invoices and that Redwood can support an Aurora PO number on invoices.

Attached: Aurora-PO-Template.docx (our preferred PO format). Once we have the PO/contract path and references, happy to schedule a call with Daniel for a final case review - afternoons PST work for us next week.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager, Aurora Tech
